shared_elements: low-relief carved figures shown in strict profile facing right
bearded human-headed figure(s) with elaborately curled/patterned hair and beard
raised arm/hand gesture with articulated fingers
patterned garment or body surface rendered as repeated scale/feather-like units
animal features rendered with dense stylized texture
procession-like alignment of figures along a horizontal ground line
decorative border band framing the scene
justification: Both show low-relief profile figures on a common groundline with beards/hair rendered as tight rows of stylized curls, one hand raised and fingers carefully articulated, and dense repeated scale- or feather-like patterning filling wings, fleece and garments — a distinctly shared repertoire of conventions. The subjects differ, however: A is a single winged raptor-headed composite being holding a bucket-like object, while B is a multi-figure procession of men leading horned rams between floral rosette borders.
